title: The Hallway Track: AI Adoption Is Accelerating
description:
From fintech to energy trading, we asked attendees at AI Engineer SF how their industries are actually adopting AI right now. Some teams are racing in head-first to stay competitive; others are more hesitant, still building trust in the output. A quick, honest snapshot of where adoption really stands across different industries.

Part of The Hallway Track — real conversations, caught between sessions, at AI Engineer SF.
